title: Cancellation Refund Window and Account Closure Terms by Tier — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** — cancellation and closure figures per tier.

| Tier | Full-refund window after the current term's fee was charged | Prorated refund after the window | When a cancellation outside the window takes effect | Points and open certificates forfeited when the rewards account is closed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 0 calendar days | No | immediately | Yes |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 0 calendar days | No | immediately | Yes |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 0 calendar days | No | immediately | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 0 calendar days | No | at the end of the billing period | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 30 calendar days | No | at the end of the term | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 30 calendar days | No | at the end of the term | Yes |

### Column definitions

1. *Full-refund window*: the calendar days after the current term's fee was charged within which a cancellation refunds that fee in full. Only the two annual paid tiers have a window (30 days); Tailwise Plus Monthly has none.
2. *Prorated refund after the window*: whether a cancellation after the full-refund window refunds the unused part of the term. No tier provides one.
3. *Effective point*: when a cancellation of the tier takes effect outside the full-refund window — at once for the free tiers, at the end of the billing period for Tailwise Plus Monthly, and at the end of the term for Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual.
4. *Forfeiture on closure*: on every tier, closing the rewards account forfeits the points balance and the open certificates.

### Side-by-side

The annual paid tiers are the only tiers with a full-refund window; outside it, no tier refunds any part of the term, and the paid tier simply runs to its effective point.
